note: Generated by the SDK-208 prototype (Claude playing the generate-migration-guide step) from the deterministic bundle in .tmp/sdk-upgrade/3.0.0-alpha.32__3.1.0-alpha.5. High-signal themes verified against the api-report diffs; the core changes that no example app currently imports are listed as required for completeness but may be no-ops per app.

changes.from: hook(config: UseZamaConfig, options?)  // UseZamaConfig = { tokenAddress, wrapperAddress? }
changes.detection: Calls to any affected hook whose first argument is an object literal `{ tokenAddress, wrapperAddress? }`.
changes.action: Replace the first config-object argument with the bare token address. `useUnshield({ tokenAddress, wrapperAddress: tokenAddress }, opts)` becomes `useUnshield(tokenAddress, opts)`. For ERC-7984 the wrapper IS the token, so `wrapperAddress` is dropped (it was redundant).

changes.from: interface UseZamaConfig { tokenAddress: Address; wrapperAddress?: Address }
changes.detection: Imports or type references to `UseZamaConfig`, or hook config interfaces that `extends UseZamaConfig`.
changes.action: Remove `UseZamaConfig` usage. Mutation hooks now take a positional `address`; query hooks take a config object whose token field is named `address` (see next change).

Rename the `tokenAddress` key to `address` (and `tokenAddresses` to `addresses`). `useShield({ tokenAddress, wrapperAddress: tokenAddress })` becomes `useShield({ address: tokenAddress })`; `wrapperAddress` is no longer part of these configs.
Rename to `useDelegatedDecrypt`. Mutation params type `DelegatedUserDecryptMutationParams` becomes `DelegatedDecryptMutationParams`.
Rename `useAllow`->`useGrantPermit`, `useIsAllowed`->`useHasPermit`, `UseIsAllowedConfig`->`UseHasPermitConfig`. `UseHasPermitConfig.contractAddresses` is now `Address[]` (was a non-empty tuple).
Rename to `useWrappedToken`; the return type is now `WrappedToken` (see the core `ReadonlyToken` removal).
Pass an `EncryptedInput[]` (from `@zama-fhe/sdk/query/user-decrypt`) instead of the previous query-config object.

changes.from: useCreateEIP712, useCreateDelegatedUserDecryptEIP712, useGenerateKeypair, usePublicKey, usePublicParams, useRequestZKProofVerification
changes.detection: Imports/usages of any of the listed hooks.
changes.action: These low-level EIP-712 / keypair / ZK-proof primitives were removed (auto-signer resolution now lives inside the higher-level hooks). Move to the corresponding high-level hook flow; there is no drop-in replacement.
Consume the new `EncryptResult` object (hex-encoded, contract-ready) instead of raw `Uint8Array` handles/proof. See the core `EncryptResult` change.

changes.from: type Handle = Bytes32Hex; contract builders take (handle: Uint8Array, inputProof: Uint8Array)
changes.to: type EncryptedValue = Bytes32Hex; contract builders take (encryptedAmount: EncryptedValue, inputProof: Hex)
changes.detection: Imports/usages of the `Handle` type or raw-`Uint8Array` contract builders (`confidentialTransferContract`, `unwrapContract`, `finalizeUnwrapContract`, `writeConfidentialTransferContract`, etc.).
changes.action: Replace `Handle` with `EncryptedValue`; pass hex (`EncryptedValue`/`Hex`) instead of `Uint8Array` to the *Contract builders. Aligns with the encrypt->hex change (SDK-200).
Adopt the new hex-based `EncryptResult` object shape.

changes.from: class ReadonlyToken; class Token extends ReadonlyToken
changes.to: class Token (standalone); class WrappedToken extends Token
changes.action: Replace `ReadonlyToken` with `Token` (reads) or `WrappedToken` (wrap/unwrap-capable). The React equivalent is `useWrappedToken`.

changes.detection: Imports/usages of `createZamaConfig` from any entry point.
changes.action: Rename to `createConfig`. The package path already namespaces it, so the `Zama` prefix was dropped. (react-viem already uses `createConfig` — no-op there.)
Use `createConfig` for config assembly; relayers are configured through the transport options (see the `relayer`->`options` rename). No public `buildRelayer`.

changes.detection: Transport/relayer-pool factory calls passing a `relayer:` field.
changes.action: Rename the `relayer` parameter to `options` on transport factories.
Drop the `chainIds` argument; the function is now 2-arg.

changes.to: sdk.signer: GenericSigner | undefined; grouped under sdk.decryption / sdk.delegations / sdk.permits; sdk.createToken(address) / sdk.createWrappedToken(address)
changes.detection: Calls to `sdk.requireSigner(...)` or the removed flat `ZamaSDK` methods (allow, isAllowed, userDecrypt, delegateDecryption, revokeDelegation, createReadonlyToken, ...).
changes.action: Replace `sdk.requireSigner(op)` with the `sdk.signer` property and a null guard (`const signer = sdk.signer; if (!signer) throw ...`). Re-route the removed flat methods through `sdk.decryption`, `sdk.delegations`, `sdk.permits`; use `createToken`/`createWrappedToken` instead of `createReadonlyToken`.
Optional: new capability-grouping classes are available; no migration required for existing callers.
